caseName: St. Louis Southwestern Railway Co. v. City of Tyler
caseNameFull: ST. LOUIS SOUTHWESTERN RAILWAY COMPANY v. CITY OF TYLER, TEXAS
syllabus: Writ of error to review 99 Texas, 491, dismissed for want of jurisdiction, there being a non-Federal ground on which the judgment rested sufficient to sustain it without regard to the Federal question, if any, involved.
summary: WRIT OP ERROR TO THE SUPREME COURT OP TEXAS.
attorneys: Mr. Cone Johnson, Mr. Horace Chilton, Mr. Ben B. Cain and Mr. Jamas M. Edwards, for defendants in error in support of the motion., Mr. E. B. Perkins and Mr. Hiram, Glass for plaintiffs in error. ,

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Writ of error dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Eustis v. Bolles, 150 U. S. 361; Railway Company v. Fitzgerald, 160 U. S. 556; Moran v. Horsky, 178 U. S. 205; Johnson v. Risk, 137 U. S. 300-307; Chicago & Alton Railroad v. Wiggins Ferry Company, 119 U. S. 615; Eagan v. Hart, 165 U. S. 188.
